summary: Aroostook County lookout: a state station in 1909, a 48-foot steel tower erected in 1918. The FFLA lists the steel still standing with its cab no longer in place.

facts.design: Steel lookout tower, 48 feet; its cab is no longer in place
facts.status_note: The steel tower still stands, but its cab is no longer in place (FFLA).

notes_for_editor: No current access, ownership or cab-removal date found. Searches returned an unrelated Round Mountain in Albany Township near Bethel (private land with a trail, no tower), and the FFLA list shows a different Round Mountain in Franklin County (a tree, gone); neither was used. A geocaching page describing an old tower names no county and was not used. Height of 48 ft (14.6 m) agrees with the record. Visit and access keys omitted until confirmed.
